notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Whitemane Lion
description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
